NewsArticle.Title: Craft Enhancements
NewsArticle.Content:
Labor: Any Aisling may increase the amount of time another Aisling has by working for him or her. For example, if a Rogue has spent his six Temuairan days smithing magical rings, he may find a peasant or anyone to give him labor, so that he may do more crafts or do anything else that requires time. See the storage Higglers of the villages.
Rogues may Higgle with one of the Higglers who also stores goods, to obtain up to a dozen items that may or may not be available in the usual market.
- Cherries
- Grapes
- Parchment Scrolls
- Wine
- Wolf Skin
Rogues may now smith a sword or a soori in half the time. Rogues may style hair in a third of the time.
Wizards may produce three Arcane Scrolls from parchment where before they could produce one. These scrolls are valuable, especially when identified, because singing the song on the scroll brings the singer to the location the song is written about.
Wizards may research in almost half the time as before, taking only a full Temuairan day to research once. Wizards may also enchant in almost half the time as before.
Priests may mix three times as much beothaich deum, which is the red potion that restores someone to consciousness.
Warriors and other tailors may tailor in less than half the time as before, including Regional Tailoring only if you are a citizen of that region.
See [interactive](http://www.darkages.com/pics/index_feature.html) features screenshots.
